findings.issue: defaultTemplateRenderer uses html=false; EmailChannelDriver (T-0170) uses text: job.body (plain-text SMTP). Code comment documents that HTML email would require a separate renderNotification(..., {html:true}) call, but no follow-up task tracks this. Gap is safe for day-1 but needs a future task when HTML email bodies are introduced.
findings.suggestion: Create a follow-up task (e.g. T-xxx) tracking 'HTML email render path: EmailChannelDriver must call renderNotification with html=true before SMTP send'. Minimal spec change: add 'Email HTML body render path' to Out-of-Scope with explicit follow-up reference.

findings.issue: No test for fullwidth Unicode lookalike chars (U+FF1C ＜, U+FF1E ＞) to explicitly document they are not HTML-dangerous and not escaped. Not a security gap — HTML parsers do not interpret fullwidth as tags — but an explicit test would make the decision auditable.
findings.suggestion: Add: it('escapeHtml: fullwidth < and > are not HTML-dangerous, not escaped', () => { expect(escapeHtml('＜script＞')).toBe('＜script＞'); });
